label: Declaration of assets and declaration of interests as Minister-Delegate
detail: As a member of the Lecornu government, Nicolas Forissier filed declarations of assets (declaration de situation patrimoniale) and of interests with the Haute Autorite pour la transparence de la vie publique (HATVP); the HATVP published declarations of members of the Lecornu government. Specific figures were not extracted for this dataset.

label: Declaration of interests and assets as deputy for Indre
detail: As a sitting deputy, Forissier is subject to HATVP declaration obligations; his declarant file is available on the HATVP website. Specific figures were not extracted for this dataset.
